## Summary

Reconcile the complete v0.92.1 next-milestone package and author the complete v0.92.2 CodeFriend Beta 1 planning package before v0.92 closes. This issue updates planning documents only. It must not create, label, move, or close any execution issue.

## Operator direction

- #314 and #315 are non-gating for this #316 planning run.
- v0.92 remains active until its closeout is complete.
- The v0.92.1 and v0.92.2 issue waves remain number-free and uncreated until the operator opens each milestone.
- Administrative closeout is asynchronous and is not an execution dependency.
- CodeFriend Beta 1 is a complete product milestone in v0.92.2 and must meet the Drive-derived v1 technical exit bar; older v0.93-v0.95 alpha scheduling is superseded.

## Required outcome

Produce complete, internally consistent, reviewable v0.92.1 and v0.92.2 planning packages. Reconcile canonical repository truth with relevant local TBD and Google Drive candidates, give every candidate an explicit disposition, and define a number-free CodeFriend Beta 1 execution wave without creating its issues.

## Required planning additions and dispositions

1. Coordinated but provider-specific AWS and GCP account move-in/normalization planning in the corporate-transfer lane, with no cloud mutation authority.
2. Runtime v2/v3 decoupling as a first-class v0.92.1 planning track.
3. Provider inference profiles and bounded local-model shadow execution, excluding deferred MLX/Metal and OCI packaging.
4. GCP six-resident qualification as a distinct optional distributed-Runtime sidecar with no paid-run authority.
5. A complete v0.92.2 CodeFriend Beta 1 package covering product shell, portable Adapter v2, evidence core, architecture cognition, executable governance, specialist review and synthesis, human publication controls, longitudinal intelligence, integrations and exports, documentation, fixtures, and ADL plus external-repository proof.
6. Truthful routing for existing #251, #84, #122, #345, and historical #457 without remote mutation here.
7. Unambiguous predecessor routing for #188-#190.
8. Agent Technical English (ATE) is a reviewed deferred research program, provisionally targeted at v0.94. It is not a v0.92.1 or v0.92.2 work package and is not a CodeFriend dependency. Later work must prove ATE capability lift before model training or Runtime integration.
9. Explicit deferral of Jira, Linear, Slack, broad Workspace integration, autonomous repository mutation, public customer-scale deployment, security tournaments, ATE, and optional modernization automation unless separately admitted.

## Owned paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/**`
- `docs/planning/ADL_FEATURE_LIST.md`
- `.csdlc/issues/316/**`
- `.csdlc/prepared/issues/316/**`
- `.csdlc/evidence/316/**`

## Read-only inputs

- Relevant `.adl/docs/TBD/**` plans are discovery evidence only and never tracked authority.
- Google Drive CodeFriend product, build, setup, adapter, and security plans are discovery evidence only; tracked planning must be context-free.
- The Google Drive ATE research document is discovery evidence for the deferred ATE disposition.
- Existing GitHub issues and closed predecessor packets are read-only routing evidence.
- Unmerged planning commit `0d50d0841` is input to reconcile, not merged authority.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every canonical planned ID and promoted existing issue appears exactly once with dependency and disposition truth.
- Every relevant candidate has an explicit source-grounded disposition without a tracked `.adl` or Google Drive runtime dependency.
- AWS/GCP move-in planning, Runtime decoupling, provider profiles, and GCP qualification remain within their stated boundaries.
- The complete canonical v0.92.2 planning set exists and defines the full CodeFriend Beta 1 technical exit bar, number-free work packages, proof matrix, release tail, and v0.93 handoff.
- Architecture cognition, governance, four-perspective review, evidence, publication, longitudinal comparison, installation, exports, and two proving repositories are explicitly covered.
- ATE is recorded as deferred v0.94 research outside both issue waves and the CodeFriend dependency chain.
- YAML, JSON, Markdown links, planned-ID uniqueness, dependency references, no-`.adl` guards, exact scope, and diff hygiene pass.
- One bounded exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.

## Non-goals

- Creating v0.92.1 or v0.92.2 issues or activating either milestone
- Closing v0.92
- Runtime v4 implementation
- MLX/Metal or OCI packaging implementation
- Paid AWS or GCP execution
- Implementing CodeFriend Beta 1 in this planning issue
- ATE implementation, benchmark execution, model training, or Runtime integration
- Release dates or release approval

## Execution boundary

Use typed C-SDLC v2 in the issue-bound FastWork worktree. Stop after a reviewed planning PR. Issue creation remains held until v0.92 closes and the operator explicitly releases the hold.
